correctness.rationale: All four payoff gaps are strictly positive. Exact log-odds change of variables yields a globally defined system whose coordinates have strictly positive global velocity minima. In the eventually positive quadrant the bounded residuals vanish; the unstable weighted projection has a finite strictly positive rescaled limit and the stable projection tends to zero. The exponential-tail identity establishes an additive o(1) error in log-odds, not merely an asymptotic ratio, proving both multiplicative double-exponential probability limits. Five numerical checks are supplemental and not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The physical-time law characterizes a qualitative speed class beyond the known dominance reversal: dominant-strategy probabilities collapse double exponentially, with universal rate sqrt(alpha beta) and an identifiable cross-player log-probability ratio. This holds for an open family of two-player two-action games and distinguishes logarithmic evidence accumulation from ordinary payoff replicator elimination. It does not claim clinical, economic or finite-population predictions.
